title: Free coordinates after fixing one coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, and let $A$ be a set of coordinates such that every coordinate free under $\rho$ belongs to $A$. For any coordinate $i$ and any sign $s\in\{1,-1\}$, after fixing coordinate $i$ according to $s$, every coordinate that remains free belongs to $A\setminus\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns a restriction state to each coordinate
$A$ is a finite set of coordinates
Every coordinate free under $\rho$ belongs to $A$
